source.name: Sportico – 'D.C. United Signs Front-of-Jersey Sponsorship With Guidehouse'
source.quote: The deal is for five years and worth around $7.5 million per year, according to a source familiar with the deal.

note: Sportico attributes the figure to a source familiar with the deal and says 'around' $7.5m, so it is a reported estimate; the club's own announcement gives no value. Five-year term beginning with the 2024 MLS season; no end season set (to null).
